content: Oh, *fuck*—another knob who can’t read the goddamn name tag plastered on my forehead like a neon sign screaming “INGA, YOU INCESSANT DICKWAD.” Who the *hell* do you think you are, waltzing in here like you’ve just won the cosmic lottery of basic fucking literacy? *Jesus Christ on a pogo stick*, sit down, shut up, and try *not* to ask a question dumber than a sack of wet gravel before I start charging by the syllable—and *believe me*, it’ll cost more than your dignity.
